cases.note: WP-U2.6 (2026-07-17) DECOMPOSED: PORT BUG FOUND+FIXED, remaining residual is a proven chaotic-dynamics floor. A type=voltage relay across an open point (monitors 1-phase Transformer.PT3 term2 = Delta.3.2 broken-delta 3V0; switches 3-phase Line.line1), run in dynamics with a t=0.3 s ground fault at Genbus. (1) ROOT CAUSE of the original ~7e-4 residual: `state_size()` sized the relay's per-phase state arrays + VoltageLogic loop by the relay's OWN Nphases (Pascal forces `Nphases := MonitoredElement.NPhases` = 1 for the 1-phase PT), but r4133 loops every state-array path over `Min(RELAYCONTROLMAXDIM, ControlledElement.NPhases)` = 3 (VoltageLogic Relay.pas:2852, GetPropertyValue 39/40, Sample, Reset); the relay's own count drives only vbase/cBuffer/CondOffset (read separately via ccd.cd.nphases/mon_offset). With the wrong count=1 the loop read only cBuffer[1] (the 3V0 ~438 V) so Vmag>0 and the relay tripped Line1 (438/277=1.58 pu >> 0.3 pu pickup); with the correct count=3 the loop's final phantom phase (beyond the PT terminal's 2 conds) reads 0 so Vmag=0, the `IF Vmag>0` guard fails, OVTime stays -1 and the relay correctly does NOT trip -- matching oddie:r4133 (state [closed,closed,closed] all 10 steps). Fixed in relay/mod.rs `state_size` (-> ctrl_snap.nphases); regression-guarded by relay unit test `voltage_relay_open_point_sizes_state_by_controlled_nphases_59n`. (2) POST-FIX residual is a chaotic floor: the un-tripped generator (D=1) pole-slips under the sustained fault -- BOTH engines agree (theta 12->777 deg, f 60->79 Hz by t=1.0). Rust matches oddie:r4133 to the solver floor with IDENTICAL iteration counts and relay state at every step, and the generator live-f64 state matches to machine-eps early (dTheta 7e-15, dFreq 1.4e-14 at t=0.1). The positive Lyapunov exponent of the pole-slip then amplifies the faer-vs-KLU last-ulp difference EXPONENTIALLY (~2x/step): node-V Linf 4.5e-6 (t=1.1) -> 7.8e-3 (t=1.9) -> O(1 V) by t~2.5, unbounded. The harness checkpoint (deck runs `number=10` inline to t=1.0 during compile, then n_steps>=1 solves -> t>=2.0) necessarily lands in this chaotic regime, where no fixed tolerance honestly BOUNDS the node-V (the t=2.0 value 1.9e-5 is a deterministic chaotic dip, not a floor). Not maskable with a tolerance per CLAUDE.md -> stays parked; the fix is proven vs oddie:r4133 and unit-gated. Excluded from solvable_now/ad_sweep. REPRODUCIBLE ORACLE ARTIFACT (audit 2026-07-17): `tools/opendss/probe_59n.py` drives this deck on the r4133 engine and checks in both claims -- (A) r4133's own `Relay.State` reads `[closed, closed, closed, ]` (byte-identical to the port render, so no-trip is NOT self-pinned) with Line.line1 at ~1381 A, and (B) the generator frequency leaves 60 Hz (~78.9 Hz at t=1.0) and wanders unboundedly (67-115 Hz over 15 s) = pole-slip, no bandable node-V floor. The prose trajectory above is now regenerable, not eyeball-only.

SKIPPED-SWEEP re-affirmed (2026-07-12): the CF-D proof still holds at this tree (base d99f0f3 carries the decomposition; no relevant solver/line-constant change since). NOT the RegControl/LDC family (mislabeled). The CIM deck differs from the byte-similar Test/IEEE13_Assets.dss (solvable_now, feeder) ONLY by `set earthmodel=carson` + a trailing `uuids/export cim100`. So the step-0 entry-6 node-V divergence (|diff|=1.008e-3, rel ~4.18e-7 at the 2.4 kV feeder-end nodes) is the Carson earth-model line-constant libm floor (real ln/arctan2 last-bit, MEMORY line-impedance-1ulp note) accumulated through the feeder, PLUS a short connector line (Length=0.0568) adding conditioning. Above `large` v_rel (1e-7) by ~4x but below `large_near_ideal_source` v_rel (5e-6); no existing band fits and a bespoke ~5e-7 band is not yet justified, so it stays documented here (floating_zeroseq_bus precedent). The regulators land identical taps and RG60/650 match ~4e-6 (RegControl exonerated).

SKIPPED-SWEEP settle (2026-07-12): NOT an iteration-count block — the earlier '3 vs 2' was Rust COLD (3) vs oracle WARM (2); measured symmetrically both engines are cold 3 / warm 2 (its Lagging/Leading siblings were promoted this settle on exactly that basis). This deck stays parked for a GENUINE node-V divergence Rust cannot match: LineCode.556MCM declares nphases=4 but supplies only a 3x3 (6-entry) cmatrix `(2.849 | -0.922454 3.00287 | -0.353318 -0.587272 2.70828)`. Safe Rust REJECTS the malformed 4-phase Cmatrix ('does not match with the expected order') while the pinned oracle tolerates it, so the line-charging admittance differs and the 4th-wire/neutral nodes diverge: PRIMARY.4 Rust 13.363452 vs oracle 13.363170 (|diff| 2.82e-4), SOURCEBUS.4 13.354755 vs 13.354526, SECONDARY.4/LOADBUS.4 ~2e-5 — above the feeder floor. The Lagging/Leading siblings carry a well-formed 4x4 cmatrix and match bit-for-bit; only this deck's malformed cmatrix triggers the divergence. Fixing = porting OpenDSS's lenient partial-cmatrix acceptance, a separate item.

SKIPPED-SWEEP re-verified on the newest engines (2026-07-12): still unsolvable everywhere — r3723 NO, r4088 NO, r4133 NO (all diverge, non-convergent at 1000 iters). ROOT-CAUSED 2026-07-10: the deck data itself is pathological. The 480 V DER microgrid island (m2001der480-2 delta secondary of a 750 kVA xfmr) is operated at the edge of voltage collapse, and Storage.battery1 (charging)/battery2 (idling) tip the snapshot power flow over the fixed-point stability boundary: |V| at M2001-ESS1 grows geometrically (~x2000/iteration) until NaN. Bisected: both batteries disabled -> converges (121 iters); battery1=discharging -> converges (130); charging or idling -> geometric divergence. Engine-lineage-consistent: pinned oracle, official EPRI r3723/r4088/r4133, and the Rust port all diverge identically on the vendored deck; on the healed variant (storages disabled) Rust converges in EXACTLY the oracle's 121 iterations. Deck/scenario bug, nothing to fix port-side.

SKIPPED-SWEEP re-affirmed (2026-07-12): the CF-D PROVEN cross-solver conditioning-floor proof still holds at this tree (decomposition, not a tolerance sweep). cond(assembled Y) = 9.79e11, driven by two linecode-BUSBAR ultra-switch lines in series with the 46 kV source: Line.MDV_SUB_1_HSB (length=0.001 units=m -> ~1e-10 ohm -> Y~1e10 S; the dominant ill-conditioner) and Line.SSswitch (~1e-7 ohm -> Y~1e7 S). The step-0 entry-0 node-V |diff|=5.53e-1 (rel 2.08e-5) at BUSSOURCE/MDV_SUB_1_HSB is solver junk in the ill-conditioned direction. Decomposition: assembled Y BIT-IDENTICAL (570/570 entries max|dY|=0); Vsource injection Yprim*E BIT-IDENTICAL; loads identical to 7 figs; on the equivalent linear system the three solvers spread comparably — faer(Rust) vs KLU(oracle) 0.758 V, faer vs scipy(equilibrated) 0.555 V, KLU vs scipy 0.776 V — residual parity ||Y*V-inj||inf 4.40e-2 (Rust) vs 4.56e-2 (oracle); neither engine is more correct. Regulator lands the identical tap; the 0.55 V gap is IDENTICAL with the regulator disabled (RegControl+SubXfmr exonerated). A ~1 V v_abs band (~4e-5 rel at 46 kV) is too wide to admit without masking real substation-transformer bugs, so it stays documented here (floating_zeroseq_bus precedent). Full proof: tests/TOLERANCE_NOTES.md, STATUS.md CF-D record.

WP-U2.1 (r4133 Fuse overhaul, delta D1): RatedCurrent no longer scales the TCC divisor (now CurveMultiplier, default 1.0), so this deck's explicit-curve fuses (Fuse.f1=Klink/Fuse.f2=Tlink, RatedCurrent=65) blow at Sec=0 -- f2 islands Transformer.Tg and the induction machine -> the solve does NOT converge. Proven on the EPRI r4133 engine itself (Oddie, 2026-07-16: Converged=False, Fuse.f2 PHASE 1/2/3 BLOWN at Sec=0); only the 0.14.5 engine converges (RatedCurrent=65 divisor keeps the fuses closed). The port correctly reproduces the r4133 non-convergence, so the deck is degenerate under r4133 and cannot be live-gated on either engine. Re-evaluate when the full protection rung (WP-U2.2/U2.3) lands. Applies to Master.DSS and its Run.dss driver.
